_comment: Per-REPOSITORY settings for scripts/goal_guard.py. The goal JSON in .goal/
is the per-RUN config (what to check, when to release); this is the part
that is true of the repository no matter which run is armed.
It is COMMITTED on purpose. .goal/ is gitignored per-run state, so a config
living there would vanish on a fresh clone and the guard would silently
revert to defaults that are wrong for this repo.
Both keys are optional; a repo with no .goal-guard.json at all is a working
